_comment: The Scoreboard's ledger. During EVERY build, log each scoreable claim the issue prints (tracking numbers, odds, 'too new to call' verdicts, forecasts) as {issue, desk, claim, check_by (ISO date or event), outcome:null}. Each SATURDAY edition grades everything gradeable (outcome: 'right'|'wrong'|'push' + one-line result) and prints The Scoreboard from the graded rows. Prune graded rows older than ~3 weeks.

claims.claim: The Fed holds rates at the 28-29 Jul FOMC (no hike), per ~83% market-implied odds
claims.result: Fed HELD 3.50-3.75% at the 28-29 Jul FOMC — 5th straight hold — but on a hawkish 9-3 split, with three dissents wanting a HIKE (graded No. 59).

claims.claim: MAS keeps policy settings unchanged at its ~27 Jul quarterly statement
claims.result: MISS. MAS TIGHTENED (steeper S$NEER slope) at its 27 Jul statement rather than holding pat (graded No. 59).

claims.claim: Regime call: higher-for-longer, oil-driven inflation bid, firm dollar persists
Moonshot releases Kimi K3 open weights on 27 Jul as promised
claims.result: Kimi K3 weights went live ~26-27 Jul as promised; Unsloth published dynamic GGUF quants on 29 Jul (graded No. 59).

claims.claim: DeepSeek legacy chat/reasoner API endpoints stop resolving after 15:59 UTC 24 Jul
claims.result: Retired on schedule at 15:59 UTC 24 Jul; the deepseek-chat/-reasoner aliases now fail (graded on No. 52 Scoreboard).

claims.claim: Spider-Man: Brand New Day opens above US$180m domestic (31 Jul)
claims.result: Effectively locked: $72M Thursday previews (an all-time US record) and a $167M+ opening DAY (also a record) make a 3-day above $180M a formality; audience score 98% (ties the MCU record). The 3-day final lands Mon 3 Aug (graded No. 59).

The 10-day Gulf ceasefire proposal is not accepted by both sides within a week
claims.result: Iran rejected the Iraqi-brokered 10-day truce outright on 24 Jul over Hormuz; unaccepted within the week.

claims.claim: MAS keeps policy settings unchanged at its ~27 Jul quarterly statement
claims.result: MISS. MAS TIGHTENED the S$NEER slope on 27 Jul, not a flat hold (graded No. 59).

claims.result: Kimi K3 weights went live ~26-27 Jul as promised; Unsloth published dynamic GGUF quants on 29 Jul (graded No. 59).

claims.result: Confirmed: independent testers put Kimi K3 at ~51% on AA-Omniscience — up from K2.6’s 39% and omitted from Moonshot’s own charts (graded No. 59).

claims.result: MISS. MAS did NOT stand pat: on 27 Jul it TIGHTENED, steepening the S$NEER appreciation slope (band width and centre unchanged). We called a flat hold; the slope moved (graded No. 59).
